svg.aria-label: tejas@arch: programmer, low-level nerd. Arch + Sway, Vim. Writes C, C++, TypeScript and Lua. Interested in operating systems, networking, distributed systems, databases, compilers and how computers work. Currently writing a Redis in C++.

text.tspan: code: the hidden language of computer hardware and software
i write software, then take it apart to see how it works.
, anything that shows what the machine is *actually* doing.
usually found in a terminal, reading man pages for fun.
be kind, share what you know, help where you can.
writing a redis in c++, one syscall at a time.
